decks.name: LeetCode #42 - Trapping Rain Water
decks.description: Calculate how much rainwater can be trapped after raining given an elevation map

cards.question: Trapping Rain Water: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

solutions.name: Two Pointers
solutions.explanation: Use two pointers from both ends with leftMax and rightMax tracking the maximum heights seen so far. Move the pointer with the smaller max height inward, as water trapped at that position depends on the minimum of left and right maximums. This achieves O(n) time with O(1) space.
